Here's what I understood - let me play it back before touching code:
1. Reorder the Data Cleanser sub-tabs Currently: Clean Data -> Summary -> Detected Characters You want: Detected Characters -> Summary -> Clean Data
2. Each button jumps to its own relevant sub-tab, not just to the "3. Data Cleanser" main tab like now. My read on the mapping:

* Check data for QR supports -> lands on Detected Characters (since that's literally what Check produces - the unsafe-character list)
* Clean data for QR supports -> lands on Clean Data (the cleaned output)
* Generate/Queue-from-clean buttons don't touch the sub-tabs at all - they leave the Cleanser view (jump to QR Sequence, or just toast a queue confirmation), so no change needed there

(If you actually wanted Check to land on Summary instead of Detected Characters, tell me and I'll swap it.)
3. Pair text + QR image together in storage Right now the chunk data (`chunks_meta.rds`, per-chunk `.rds`, `stream.rds`) keeps text (`wrapped`/`raw`) and rendered images as parallel lists. You want each chunk stored as one self-contained unit - `list(text = ..., image = ...)` per chunk - so a text preview can pull the matching text for whatever chunk is currently playing.
4. Add a text-preview panel in the "2. QR Sequence" tab, left column, positioned right below the existing Loop toggle / Auto-return toggle / helpText block (below that whole block, above the Segment/Payload/Caption labels that follow it). It should show the current chunk's text live as playback advances.
One thing I'll need to pick a default for: should the preview show the raw original text for that chunk, or the full wrapped payload (the version with the header/session-id/checksum actually encoded into the QR)? I'll default to raw text (more readable), unless you want the exact wrapped payload shown instead.
Did I get all four right? Once you confirm (or correct the assumptions above), I'll make the changes.


1. Neither you made reorder of subtabs in cleanser page. Nor its auto opening on button press.
2. The text preview or qr streaming is not working either.


Two different things going on here - let me take them separately.

**The crash** - that's a division-by-zero/Infinity bug, not a typo. It happens in the progress bar:

```r
pct <- round(100 * current_index() / n)
```

If `n` (i.e. `length(gc$chunks)`) is `0`, `current_index() / 0` is `Inf`, `round(Inf)` is still `Inf`, and `sprintf("...%d...", Inf)` throws exactly that error - `%d` can't format a non-finite value. `n` only becomes `0` if `gc$chunks` is `NULL` - which happens if `gc` is a **stream object left over from before this change** (old `stream.rds`/`chunks_meta.rds` files on disk still have the old `raw`/`wrapped`/`images` shape, no `chunks` field at all). This is exactly the caveat I flagged at the end of my last message - any task that was already queued/rendered under the old code will load into the new code as an object with no `$chunks`, and everything downstream breaks. If you've got anything sitting in `store/Library/` from before, that's almost certainly it - clearing that folder (or deleting/re-queuing just the affected tasks) should stop the crash. I'll also add a defensive guard so a malformed/legacy object shows an error message instead of crashing the whole render:
